title: Special Executive Masters Programme in Human Resource Management
description: SEMP in Human Resource Management is for high-performance managers and directors who want to link human resources with the organisation's strategic objectives to improve performance.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and Rushford Business School
longDescription: Course Overview The GSS Special Executive Masters Programmes (SEMP) allows you to update your skills, develop new skills, and explore and develop interests in a wide range of topics. These courses can be taken as personal or professional development and may enhance your employability. The encapsulated Senior Executive Programme in Human Resource Management is for high-performance managers and directors who want to link human resources with the strategic objectives of the organisation to improve performance. The programme is also useful for managers and directors who want the organisation's policies and procedures related to employees to fit into the organization’s broader strategic plan. The SEMP (HRM) will equip you with the fundamentals needed to be an effective change agent as an entrepreneur, manager or consultant. In addition, the programme will equip you with an awareness of business realities related to Human Resources issues and real-world problem-solving skills.
courseDetails: Mode of Study Using Web-based technology, this program provides self-paced, individualized instruction that can be taken anywhere and anytime an individual has access to a computer and the Internet. This programme is suitable for successful professionals or specialists in the private, public, or voluntary sectors who have new management responsibilities and need to expand their management knowledge quickly. This Programme serves as a refresher course for those who had their Master's a long time ago and need quick reminders and professional/ academic updates. At the same time, it also serves as a primer for experienced Professionals who never made time out for their masters. Yet, they require the academic and practical relevance of this master’s experience. It is a short executive training that runs online for three months. Upon successfully completing the Programme, candidates will be awarded a Continuing Professional Development (CPD) certificate in the specific Programme they have achieved. What is a CPD Course? Continuing Professional Development (CPD) is how professionals maintain and enhance their knowledge and skills. The world is constantly moving at a very fast pace. Hence, undertaking CPD is essential to support a professional in his/her current role as well as helping them with career progression. CPD is all about upgrading knowledge, skills, and capabilities to remain effective and compliant. A CPD course is an investment that you make in yourself. It’s a way of planning your development that links learning directly to practice. CPD can help you keep your skills and knowledge up to date and prepare you for greater responsibilities. It can boost your confidence, strengthen your professional credibility, and help you become more creative in tackling new challenges. Is the SEMP Human Resource Management Programme right for me? If you want to foster a sense of team spirit and camaraderie within the organization, if your challenge is to manage the recruitment and selection of new employees as well as the training and development of new and current employees, and you want to establish and administer compensation plans and employee benefit programs, then this is just the right Programme for you. Why SEMP Human Resources Management? The SEMP (HRM) will equip you with the fundamentals needed to be an effective change agent, either as an entrepreneur, manager, or consultant. In addition, the Programme will equip you with an awareness of business realities related to Human Resources issues and real-world problem-solving skills. By the end of three months, you will have worked through several case studies, had access to numerous online academic materials, interacted with peers from different countries and backgrounds, and also received directions from the best business trainers in the business world today. Who should enrol in this online Certificate Program? The SEMP Human Resource Management Programme is designed for entry-level managers, up to mid-level managers, senior managers or directors, and consultants who are in a general management role or fast approaching such positions and are seeking an opportunity to obtain a richer, deeper understanding of management skills. modules.title: ENGAGEMENT OF EMPLOYEES AND ORGANISATIONAL LEARNING
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of contemporary issues in the Engagement of Employees, Organisational Learning, people management, and development. Learners will examine and critically evaluate the purpose and objectives of human resource management, and design and implementation of HR action plans for promoting employee engagement and organizational performance.

lessons.title: Understanding Employee Engagement Concepts
Fundamentals of Organisational Knowledge
Organisational Learning and Knowledge Management
Management Information Systems
Engagement of Employees and organizational learning

modules.title: GLOBAL RESOURCING, TALENT AND REWARD MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of the principles and practices of resourcing, Global talent management, performance and reward management in corporate contexts. Learners will acquire both theoretical and practical understanding of recruitment, selection, employee retention and dismissal and related aspects of Global talent management. The learners will also learn the diverse approaches to effective reward and performance management in the global context.

lessons.title: Relationship Between Talent, Performance And Reward Management
Understanding The Performance and Reward Management System
Introduction to Talent Management
Effective Talent Sourcing and Retention
Employee Reward Management and Payment Systems
Global Resourcing Talent And Reward Management

modules.title: LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT AND PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: This unit aims to develop learners’ strategic leadership and management knowledge and skills. The learners will also learn the role of leadership and management in enhancing teamwork, effective communication, and organizational performance. The unit reflects the nature of the roles and competencies relevant at a strategic level.

lessons.title: Leadership and Management Development Programmes
Understanding the role of motivation, teamwork and communication in leadership

Effective Talent and Performance Management
Leadership Development and Performance Management

modules.title: MANAGING EMPLOYMENT RELATIONS AND EMPLOYMENT LAW
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of the key principles that underpin Managing Employment Relations. The learners will develop understanding of employee relation & Employment Law and their purpose, specifically focusing on recruitment and selection legislation and the employment protection provided for different types of organisation.

modules.title: STRATEGIC HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The learner will gain an understanding of how the effective strategic management of human resources supports the achievement of organizational purposes in different organizational contexts. The unit seeks to analyze and evaluate the contribution of strategic human resource management to competitive advantage.
